exposure: brisk walking duration (>=1 hour/day vs. <1 hour/day)
cohort: The study included 52 full-term pregnant women (30.7 +/- 3.0 years old) at 37 weeks of gestation who wore accelerometers until delivery.
finding: Brisk walking for at least 1 hour per day in term pregnant women significantly improves cervical ripening and reduces the need for artificial cervical ripening.
gest_age: full-term, starting at 37 weeks of gestation
